probe.description: Run a command with /bin/sh -c in a scratch copy of the working tree to investigate material uncertainty or prepare and check required proof artifacts. Accepted current proposals are applied to the copy first, then optional scratch files override them for this probe only. The project and retained proposals are untouched. Stopped after 5 minutes. Reports status, timeout, wall time and combined output. With capture_output=true, successful complete UTF-8 output is kept privately as a bounded artifact handle instead of being copied into the conversation. Generate a large controls.json programmatically, print only its contents, then use propose_files from_probe to retain it. Capturing confers no ownership, readiness or approval; normal proposal validation and every gate still apply. Request every independent read_file, search_text, list_files and probe call you need in one response, and do not re-read a file you have already read unless it changed.
probe.name: probe

propose_files.description: Retain complete owned Intent or step files without checking them. Each file supplies path and exactly one of content (whole text) or from_probe (a successful captured output handle from this invocation). Use captured output for programmatically generated controls.json or other large proof artifacts without retyping repository files. Same path/protection rules as submit. Proposals accumulate privately; malformed or unsafe mixed calls retain nothing. End with submit to check the complete package.
propose_files.name: propose_files

submit.description: Include nonempty ## Source comparison prose (at most 8192 UTF-8 bytes) comparing requested behaviors and settled non-secret literals against the actual complete contract, using addressed, omitted, conflicting, superseded with source/contract references. Do not expose secrets or raw private originals. Deliberate scope changes must be explicit; mappings are diagnostic aids, not semantic proof. End shaping with exactly one of questions, Intent files, or blocked. Within this run, well-formed file proposals accumulate: omitted paths retain earlier proposals; latest content wins. Submit only corrections on editing retries. After inspecting legitimate missing-feature red, resubmit the smallest eligible owned artifact with its exact current candidate whole body, including previously proposed corrections. The files array must be nonempty; if only one eligible large artifact exists, submit its entire body. Omitted well-formed proposals remain retained; do not retransmit large unchanged prose/helpers or restore original disk bytes for acknowledgment. Publication and acknowledgment concern the exact complete package; unchanged inputs reuse readiness, while changed candidates receive fresh checks. A malformed or unsafe submission contributes no files. A blocked report is never authorization and cannot be paired with another result. Record a documentation lookup only when this conversation's documentation tool returned that status and reference. An explicit question kind other than product or handoff is rejected: decide technical questions inside shaping; only kind product or handoff may reach the caller.
submit.name: submit

decisions.description: Optional, with questions or files, never with blocked: the technical, security, protocol, storage and limit decisions this shaping made, kept across its continuations. evidence lists repository files this shaping read and ran `<command>` items of probes that succeeded; constraints are the rules the decision imposes; uncertainty states what stays uncertain and is required without evidence; revises names a recorded decision this one replaces, with why it changed and evidence this round read or ran.

kind.description: Optional. Omit or product for a UI/UX or product question. handoff for a mandatory authentication or security handoff. Any other explicit kind is rejected.

submit_refinement.description: For edits, submit changed existing files; well-formed proposals accumulate in this run and omitted paths retain earlier proposed bytes. Submit original content only to intentionally revert an edit. After inspecting legitimate missing-feature red, resubmit the smallest eligible owned artifact with its exact current candidate whole body, including previously proposed corrections. The files array must be nonempty; if only one eligible large artifact exists, submit its entire body. Omitted well-formed proposals remain retained; do not retransmit large unchanged prose/helpers or restore original disk bytes for acknowledgment. Publication and acknowledgment concern the exact complete package; unchanged inputs reuse readiness, while changed candidates receive fresh checks. Or report an explicit unsupported-work constraint.
submit_refinement.name: submit_refinement
